# owatch-docs

Built documentation site for Overwatch, served by GitHub Pages at
https://the-common-developers.github.io/owatch-docs/

**Do not edit this repository by hand.** Everything in the `gh-pages`
branch is generated HTML, overwritten wholesale by CI on every push to
`main` of `the-common-developers/owatch` (a private repo). Docs changes
belong there, in `docs/`, alongside the code they describe.
